notes.title: Methods 5 Year Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37719413/738fa96f7fe02321a467b67588cdbdff949e0c80.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=YOrd7iN49MA;full][/previewyoutube]

It was another great year for [i]Methods[/i] — the mobile version of the game is now fully released! 

And thank you as always to the fanbase for the many, many fan-created works! Your enthusiasm inspires me to keep creating better and better works.

For this anniversary, I wanted to make sure I had some really big exciting news, so for the past several months, I've been working on a secret plan to make this happen, and I'm super excited to announce it here!

[h1]File 05 Coming in May![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37719413/7be34de965ed1894b1c2cb992239b5394be7f84e.png[/img]

Keeping this a secret was pretty hard, but I was actually working on File 04 and File 05 simultaneously for the past several months! I'll have more details on how I pulled off this crazy scheme in an upcoming devlog, but for now — just know that File 05 is 95% complete.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37719413/571c5d96761cafde55de7d8a9f66007ac8b50dc2.png[/img]

We're just finishing up the Chinese translation before launching the beta on Afdian and Patreon. Because I moved up File 05's production, Hangout Four will actually be releasing afterwards, though I made sure to do a bit of work on it too so that it won't take too long for that to be released as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37719413/6b9ddf1a6a1ae73c2c369a91633f036456376700.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37719413/f05daf3b6c059d56e9ca5ee916b1b066f377d20d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37719413/72802a062a8df3054ce57390c3f2ee6c103dba3d.png[/img]

This time, Team Tads is going to Montebello — what intriguing mystery will await them there, and how will Tads lead them? Lots of surprises are in store!

[h1]Mystery Score Update[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37719413/531cdf05fb5bfa2a7cb9f31c88bfc11d630b7a18.png[/img]

Though I didn't have enough time to finish this before the anniversary, an update is in the works for [i]Methods: The Detective Competition[/i] as well. For a long time, the biggest remaining regret I've had about the game is how you're forced to replay mysteries to proceed (at least for the first two Stages of the game — from the Third Stage onward it does away with that, fortunately). It can be frustrating, especially when the game is meant to be story-focused and not really trying to challenge the player.

So with this upcoming update, I'm going to be implementing a score screen. You will be able to proceed with the story even if you get a zero-star rating, without having to replay any sections. I think this will really help eliminate some annoyance, and it also makes it more fun to choose random dialog options that you want to see, rather than the answer you think is correct.

I hope you look forward to these big upcoming updates, and if you haven't gotten the game yet — it will be on sale starting now until May 1st at the lowest discount yet — 65% off! Enjoy ;)

Until next time!

— LockedOn & Erabit.

notes.title: Major Update: Methods: The Detective Competition Celebrates Four Years!
notes.content:
It's been four years since I completed [i]Methods[/i]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37719413/a02ff736dbf2b650163af3aa73d6296e9b8b9ad4.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=8NqIBpHI470;full][/previewyoutube]

This was an extremely important year for [i]Methods[/i], as after many years of searching, I finally found and partnered with a publisher — Erabit Studios! They helped me launch the game on mobile, get merch to fans, and so much more! A big thank you to them for helping to support [i]Methods[/i]!

And thank you as always to the fanbase for the many many fan-created works! It's so great to see!

For this anniversary, I wanted to make sure there was a meaningful update to the game. This Fourth Anniversary update has some big changes which have been requested for a while!

[h1]New Hackett, Haney and Lucha Sprites![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37719413/82fac7f9146e2455a2fd35a4a35fc1d4f342b632.png[/img]

Hackett was the first character I drew for the game, and I never updated him, even though he looked a bit less polished than the other sprites in the game. I was still figuring out the style as I went. Because he kind of became the "face" of the game in all my promo images, I was a little worried about changing him at this point. But on the other hand, it's Hackett — so I decided to go for it. The new sprite fits in so well that maybe you don't even notice a difference!

Haney was the second character I drew, and I wanted to match her [i]Canada Files[/i] look better, and correct some things with her outfit. She is still her aloof self as always, and I did keep the super big bulky flashlight. And now she looks more like she does in the CGs throughout the game — even when I was making the game, I was still tweaking her design.

Lucha was also one of the first sprites I created still left mostly unchanged in the game since I began working on it. 

After this update, the "first sprites" will be the "latest sprites"! I hope that you like the new looks!

[h1]Text History[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37719413/5b16b7594260e7ed3833084a40b557909359ae76.png[/img]

This is a nice Quality of Life update which was requested for some time — now instead of being able to view previous dialogue by rolling back, you can view a text history screen, easily accessible from the dialog box. 

[h1]New Side Images[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37719413/913c4bad56071f1b1ee8ccfe7b8f9bf4c7e54086.png[/img]

The awkward floating heads are gone! I replaced all the old side images with new ones which show the characters' bodies as well, just like in [i]Canada Files[/i]. 

[h1]Checkmarks on Solved Evidence[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37719413/cf420dcec3d324a831226c01106d477e554ef215.png[/img]

Borrowing a feature from the mobile version of [i]Methods[/i], checkmarks now appear when you have looked at evidence during investigations!

And as a special bonus as part of the celebration, the full soundtrack to [i]Methods[/i] has been released as one big video to YouTube and bilibili ! Now you can solve mysteries with it playing in the background! ;)

[previewyoutube=ZZdVTF78PUg;full][/previewyoutube]

Enjoy the update with 60% off, and thanks for making [i]Methods[/i]' fourth year its most successful one yet!!

Until next time!

— LockedOn & Erabit.

Download here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1271300/_/

notes.title: Methods 2 Year Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37719413/acdbe57cad79c32f9536c0bf3dc95b62a6606f93.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=Y4MnfRwWE0U;full][/previewyoutube]

Two years ago, I finished [i]Methods[/i].

Thank you to everyone for continuing to create fan works and remain invested even two years after its release. Sometimes I forget how many people are into this game. A trip to Lofter helps remind me, and motivates me to continue doing this. I seriously doubt it would've gotten a fraction of this following if it wasn't for Sound of Mystery and Sanren, so I must thank them as well for shining a spotlight on it, and drawing their positive communities to the game. And thank you to the Master Translators who continue to help extend the game's reach even further by translating it into Chinese.

Out of all of my projects, I feel that Methods is the one that I really put myself into, for lack of a better term. I took everything I like the most and put it into one package, in perhaps the most shameless way I've ever done. It's a mystery story. It's a superhero story. It's a story about introverts and extroverts. It's a tournament arc. It has satirical moments. It has goofy moments. It has cringey moments. It has pretentious moments. It has earnest moments. It's very unpolished in a lot of ways. It is a true indie game.

So thank you for your support! I think it can only get better from here.

The sequel "[i]Motives[/i]" is still a long way off. This is less to do with my other projects "getting in the way", and more to do with wanting to simmer on the plot. Since it will be the end of the story, I want to be confident in it before I start production. I'm pleased to say that as of right now, I think it's shaping up well.

However, more Methods content IS coming!

[h1]Mobile Version[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37719413/43e97f7fefc8703b4351d769485a0ca524e1151d.png[/img]

I am excited to announce Methods for Mobile! Everything — including The Illusion Murders, all extra content and the Chinese translation — is being converted for iOS. In order to make it work, I'm having to remake the menus so they look better on smaller screens. We already have a working version running, which is very cool. I hope to release it on Android as well.

I think the story, with its bite-sized chapters, is well-suited for a more casual mobile experience. I don't know when it'll be finished — it's a bit of a chore to readjust so many images. But it will get done eventually.

[h1]New DLC[/h1]

My original plan was to add four 5-chapter stories featuring different characters to the base game, starting with The Illusion Murders, which was released last year. However, my plans have changed. This is for several reasons.

1. The stories I came up with were not particularly compelling
2. The base game already has lots of content without adding fifteen more chapters
3. The stories didn't contribute to the overall story in meaningful ways

I realized that I could instead concentrate on telling one, bigger, more meaningful and exciting story, and packaging it as a standalone game... So that's what I plan on doing!

Introducing... [i]Methods: The Canada Files[/i]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37719413/3f11dd46803ce248f7c7cf5022ed7b856955b57d.png[/img]

[i]Methods: The Canada Files[/i] is a standalone prequel story which shows the last few stages of the mysterious Canadian competition. Detective Larika Downs (Haney) is determined to discover the truth of the competition at all costs!!

This contest had quite a different ending from the American one, as you may be aware, which I think will be interesting to explore. It's also different in a few other ways, but I'll let that be a surprise!

I'm planning for 25 chapters. Not sure when I'll work on it, but I'm hoping to squeeze it in somewhere this year.

[h1]Vignettes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37719413/e6fc54f01817377d7aa4ee388a7cb8cd2dfc39fe.png[/img]

Vignettes are a new feature in the base game. They are brief scenes taking place around the detective competition. I'll let you discover what these scenes are yourself, because they are available right now!

Lastly, for the anniversary, [i]Methods[/i] and the [i]Methods[/i] OST are 25% off from April 25th to May 2nd. Enjoy!

Until next time!

— LockedOn.

notes.title: Update Notes for August 16th
notes.content:
Small plot inconsistencies fix. Updated Chinese version to reflect these changes.
Details below ([b]spoilers[/b]).

[b]Chapter 14[/b]: Roel now says that she is able to tell Honor apart from Red July. This is more consistent with her own method and how Honor's method works. It's also less confusing considering the conceit of the chapter (The detectives are pretending not to know Honor was acting as Red July — if Roel can't actually tell Honor from Red July, then it unnecessarily complicates the situation even more). This change also helps foreshadow the events of the Sixth Stage.
[b]Chapter 23[/b]: 772's alternate theory about the method of death had a big flaw that some reviews of the game have touched on. Namely, you can't choke yourself to death, much less cut off your own head, for the simple reason that you would lose consciousness before you died. I've changed it so that now he suggests a simpler and more reasonable "hanging" explanation, where gravity does the work of slicing off the victim's head rather than the victim themselves.

notes.title: The Illusion Murders Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37719413/46147ffad5974d72e69e79292e84d38c5e679997.png[/img]

New [i]Methods[/i] extra content [i]The Illusion Murders[/i] is now available, free for everyone who owns the full game!

- 5 new chapters
- 20 minutes of new music
- One new interview
- Two news articles

Unlocking the new chapters requires playing through Chapter 100 (or replaying it. You can use the skip button to get through it quickly). Once you see the credits roll, the first [i]Illusion Murders[/i] chapter should unlock.

Alternatively, you can unlock all of them at once by using the "unlock chapters" button in the options menu.

Anyone who owns the soundtrack will also be getting the new tracks as a free update as well!

Stay tuned for news about even more [i]Methods[/i] extra content in the future!

— LockedOn.
